run_f_gold: run f_gold to compute the number of ways a node can make a loop of size k in a complete graph with n nodes
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets to verify correctness
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which calculates loop counts in an undirected complete connected graph
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that uses the formula (pow(n-1,k) + p*(n-1)) / n for graph loop counting
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to support modular arithmetic for large n and k values
